original: コハクって、本当に美脚だよね
traducao: Kohaku, you have really gorgeous legs.

original: え？\nな、何？　いきなり
traducao: Huh?\nW-What's this, so suddenly?

original: そうよ。\nそれに、そのきめ細かな肌。\nどうしたら、そんなに美脚になれるの？
traducao: She's right.\nAnd such smooth, fine skin too.\nHow did your legs get so pretty?

original: 別に、特別な事は何もしてないよ。\n毎日トレーニングを\n欠かさなかったくらいかな
traducao: I don't really do anything special.\nJust that I never skipped\nmy daily training, I guess.

original: それよ！\nどんな事をしてたの？
traducao: That's it!\nWhat kind of training did you do?

original: う〜ん、色々やってたけど
traducao: Well, I did all kinds of things, but...

original: あっ。\nサンドバッグを蹴るトレーニングだけは\n毎日欠かさずにやってたよ
traducao: Ah.\nI never missed a single day\nof kicking the sandbag!

original: でも、音が外に響いて\n前に雪崩が起きちゃって
traducao: Though the sound echoed outside once\nand triggered an avalanche before.

original: その時は、しばらくトレーニングを\n止められちゃったけど、その時以外は\n今もずっと続ける様にしてるよ
traducao: Back then, I was banned from training\nfor a while, but other than that,\nI've kept doing it even now.

original: サンドバッグを蹴る音で\n雪崩って起きるの……？
traducao: Can the sound of kicking a sandbag\nactually cause an avalanche...?

original: だめ。\n次元が違い過ぎてる
traducao: It's no use.\nShe's on a completely different level.

original: クィック、クィッキ〜〜〜！！
traducao: Quick, Quickieee~~!!

original: 待ちなさい、晩めしっ！
traducao: Hold still, dinner!

original: そんなに怖がらなくたって大丈夫よぉ。\n美・味・し・く・いただいてあげるから∀
traducao: No need to be so scared, sweetie~\nI'll make you taste d-e-l-i-c-i-o-u-s :)
Qui...\nQuiiiiiii...

original: さあ、観念しなさい！
traducao: Come on, give it up already!

original: 待って！
traducao: Wait!

original: この子、すごく怯えてるよ？\nかわいそうだよ
traducao: This little one is terrified!\nHave a little sympathy!
Quiii...

original: あぁ〜ら、それは残念
traducao: Oh myyy, what a shame.

original: そのコの肉……ミソ和えにして食べると\n超〜〜〜〜〜〜〜美味だって\n聞いたんだけどなぁ
traducao: I heard that critter's meat...\nis suuuuper delicious when seasoned\nwith miso, though.

original: 食べずに死ねるか！　ってくらいの\n天上級の美味しさなのにぃ……
traducao: It's heavenly delicious, a dish\nto die for before you kick it...

original: あ〜〜残念。\n残念だわぁぁぁ
traducao: Aah, what a shame.\nSuch a travestyyyy.

original: いい子だね……
traducao: Good little guy...

original: ちょっと、こっちにおいで∀
traducao: Come over here for a second :)

original: ク、クィッキ〜〜〜〜！！
traducao: Qu-Quickieeeeee!!

original: あっ、逃げやがった！
traducao: Hey, it ran away!

original: そうはいかないよ！\n待ちなさーい！！
traducao: Not so fast!\nHold on a secooond!!

original: 二人ともひどいよ、もうやめてよ……
traducao: You two are so mean, please stop...

original: あ〜ら、何言ってらっしゃいますの？\nねえ、スパーダさん？
traducao: Oh my, what could you mean by that?\nRight, Spada?

original: そうだよなァ、イリア？\nお楽しみはまだまだ、これからだぜ
traducao: Damn right, Iria!\nThe fun is just getting started!

original: そんなぁあ〜〜〜
traducao: No waaay~~~

original: 二人とも、何してるの？
traducao: What are you two doing?

original: まさか、喧嘩……じゃないよね？
traducao: You aren't... fighting, are you?

original: 友達は大切にしなきゃダメだよ
traducao: You have to cherish your friends!

original: コハク……
traducao: Kohaku...

original: べっ、別にそういうワケじゃ……
traducao: I-It's not like that at all...

original: コハク〜！\nヒスイが探してた……よ！？
traducao: Kohaku~!\nHisui was looking for... you!?

original: や、やだシング！\nどこ触ってるの！？
traducao: N-No, Shing!\nWhere are you touching!?

original: 転んで、ぶつかった……だけ\nなの、に…………がくっ
traducao: I just tripped... and bumped into you...\nthat's all... *collapse*

original: おいおい……
traducao: Whoa, hey...

original: 友達は、大切に……
traducao: Cherish... your friends...

original: モグモグモグモグ
traducao: *munch* *munch* *munch* *munch*

original: コハク？　\n何を食べていますの
traducao: Kohaku?\nWhat are you eating?

original: 甘くて香ばしい香りに混じって\n懐かしい匂いがします
traducao: Mingled with a sweet, fragrant aroma,\nthere is a nostalgic scent.

original: これ？　\nこれはね
traducao: This?\nWell, you see...

original: ピーチパイのミソ和えだよ♪
traducao: It's peach pie seasoned with miso!

original: 二人とも食べる？
traducao: Do you two want some?

original: わ……私は遠慮しておきますわ
traducao: I... I shall pass, thank you.

original: あの……コハクはその食べ合わせに\n疑問を感じたりはしませんの？
traducao: Um... Kohaku, do you not question\nthat food combination?

original: 疑問？\nううん、とっても美味しいよ！
traducao: Question it?\nNope, it's super delicious!

original: モグモグモグモグ……
traducao: *munch* *munch* *munch*...

original: 甘いものとしょっぱいものを\nあえて同時に食す……
traducao: Daring to consume sweet and salty\nthings at the same time...

original: 間違いありません。\n通の食し方です
traducao: There is no doubt.\nThat is the way of a connoisseur.

original: 最近流行ってるらしいですわね。\n塩キャラメルとか、塩バニラとか
traducao: It seems to be trendy lately.\nThings like salted caramel and vanilla.

original: そうみたいだね。\nでもやっぱり、ミソが一番美味しいよ∀
traducao: Seems so.\nStill, miso is definitely the tastiest :)

original: コハク……まさに、通の中の通。\n正真正銘のミソミソですわね
traducao: Kohaku... truly a connoisseur of all.\nA bonafide miso maniac.

original: なぁコハク、メルディが話し方変か？
traducao: Say Kohaku, does Meredy talk weird?

original: ルークがな、メルディが事\n変ってからかうよぅ……
traducao: Luke makes fun of Meredy,\nsaying Meredy is weird...

original: そんな事ないよ。\nとっても可愛いと思うな
traducao: Not at all.\nI think it's very cute!

original: ほんとか？　\nほんとそう思うか？
traducao: Really?\nYou really think so?

original: うん。\nだって……
traducao: Yeah.\nBecause...

original: おらも普通さ喋ると\nこったら感じだっぺよぉ
traducao: If I speak normal like back home,\nthis is how I sound, y'know!

original: みんなびっくりするけんど\nおんどろくのは最初だけだぁ
traducao: Folks might be surprised at first,\nbut that only lasts a little bit!

original: おら、どごがおかしいだべか？
traducao: Is there somethin' weird about me?

original: ワイール！\nコハクじゃないみたいよー
traducao: Waa-i-ru!\nDoesn't sound like Kohaku at all~

original: でも、コハクはコハクよ。\n変なんかじゃないな
traducao: But Kohaku is Kohaku.\nNot weird at all, no way.

original: ……ね？　\nだから大丈夫だよ。\nメルディも気にする事ない
traducao: ...See?\nSo it's fine. You don't need\nto worry about it either, Meredy.

original: はいな……ちょっと元気出てきた
traducao: Yup-yup... Meredy feels better now.

original: コトバって面白いんだな。\nありがとな、コハク！
traducao: Words are super neat, huh.\nThank you, Kohaku!

original: ○○、聞いたよ。\nこれまでの魔物討伐数が\n３００体を超えたって
traducao: ○○, I heard.\nThe total monsters defeated so far\nhas surpassed 300!

original: ○○、\nすっごく頑張ってるねって\nみんなも噂してるよ
traducao: Everyone's talking about\nhow you're working so hard,\n○○!

original: ○○さんは\nどんどん強くなりますね。\n来たばかりの頃とは別人みたい
traducao: You keep getting stronger and stronger,\n○○. You seem like a completely\ndifferent person from when you arrived.

original: うん、わたしもそう思うな。\n気のせいか、雰囲気も少し\n変わった……かも？
traducao: Yeah, I think so too.\nIs it just my imagination, or has your\naura changed... a bit?

original: でも、怪我には気を付けて下さいね。\n何か困った事があったら、\nいつでも医務室に相談に来て下さい
traducao: Even so, please be careful of injuries.\nIf you ever have any trouble, feel free\nto come by the infirmary anytime.

original: みんなで一緒に、これからも頑張ろうね！
traducao: Let's keep doing our best together!

original: ねえ、コハク！\n食堂のメニュー表、見た？
traducao: Hey, Kohaku!\nDid you see the cafeteria menu?

original: もちろん！\nついにメニューの数が\n４０種類になって……

original: 世界中のレシピを\n見事に集めきったんだよね！！

original: コーダ、嬉しいぞ！
traducao: Coda is so happy!

original: 色んな美味いものが\nここにいるだけで食える。\nとても幸せな事なんだぞ、しかし！
traducao: Coda gets to eat tons of tasty food\njust by staying right here.\nThat makes me super happy, and how!

original: クィッキー！！
traducao: Quickieee!!

original: まさか本当に集めちゃうなんて……。\n○○も\nみんなも、本当に頑張ったよね
traducao: To think you really gathered them all...\n○○ and everyone\nworked so hard, didn't they?

original: これで、食べたいものを\n毎日選びたい放題だね！
